reason: Ad-hoc spike drivers and one-off gmsh/diagnostic experiments live in scripts/ but are not part of the MCP business path: nothing in the published set imports them and no tool invokes them. Publishing them made every release a full-tree blessing, so a reviewer had to sign ~30 files that this change never touched. Held files stay in the work tree, are named in manifest.scope.held, and a hold fails the build if published code imports them or refers to them by file name.
